$Comment: The Records tab for today, the daily board. Marked keeps it to the lines carrying that word: the library marks a daily dungeon's lines Daily, so the tab ranks today's daily runs and shows only on the Dungeons tab, and only once someone has a daily line today; every other tab, and a server with no daily dungeon, never shows it. A new day starts empty at midnight on Zone's clock; keep Zone at UTC so the tab turns over with a daily dungeon's shared layout. Keep is how many days the board holds, today included.
